device.category: monophonic semi-modular analogue synthesizer with 32-key keyboard, spring reverb, arpeggiator and sequencer
device.based_on: Moog modular (Model 15) and Minimoog circuits; released 2018.

sources.title: Moog Grandmother Owner's Manual
sources.note: Full controls, patch point index with impedances and ranges, normals, arpeggiator and sequencer, global settings, MIDI CC table, specifications.

architecture.polyphony_mode: monophonic; note priority low, high or last
architecture.patch_memory_note: No sound memory; three sequences of up to 256 steps, kept with power off.
architecture.summary: Two VCOs (triangle, saw, square, narrow pulse) with hard sync and linear FM on Oscillator 2, white noise and an instrument input into a DC-coupled mixer that overdrives above 1 o'clock, a 24 dB Moog ladder filter, a separate static 6 dB high-pass filter, one ADSR, a VCA set to ENV, KB RLS or DRONE, an LFO from 0.07 Hz to 1.3 kHz with sample and hold, a bipolar attenuator, a four-jack mult and a real spring reverb tank. Plays without patching; 41 jacks extend or override the normals.

modules.name: Keyboard and left-hand controller
modules.description: 32-key velocity-sensing keyboard with pitch and mod wheels, glide, octave transpose and the ARP/SEQ transport buttons. Produces pitch CV, gate and velocity, routed through the arpeggiator or sequencer when playing.

properties.velocity: not hard-wired; KB VEL OUT and MIDI only

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: Triangle, saw, square or narrow pulse (25%) at 32'-4'. Tuned by the rear FINE TUNE.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: Triangle, saw, square or narrow pulse at 16'-2', detunable ±7 semitones, hard sync to Oscillator 1 and linear FM.

modules.name: Instrument input
modules.description: High-gain preamp for the 1/4" INSTRUMENT IN, bringing guitar-level signals to 10 Vpp in the mixer; no gain control.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: DC-coupled three-channel mixer plus the instrument input; levels above 1 o'clock overdrive gently, higher settings harder.

modules.name: Low pass filter
modules.description: Moog 24 dB/oct ladder, 10 Hz-20 kHz, self-oscillating, with bipolar envelope amount and key tracking.

modules.name: High pass filter
modules.description: Static 6 dB/oct (one-pole) high-pass, only in the path when patched.

modules.name: Envelope
modules.description: ADSR with normal and inverted outputs; retriggers above 1.2 V.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: ENV follows the envelope; KB RLS opens fully on key down and closes with the release; DRONE stays open. VCA AMT IN multiplies (or, in DRONE, sets) the level.

modules.name: Modulation
modules.description: LFO from 0.07 Hz to 1.3 kHz (sine, sawtooth, ramp, square), 1 V/oct rate input, reset input, and sample and hold.

modules.name: Sample and hold
modules.description: Samples the noise source at each zero crossing of the LFO. No internal routing: patch S/H OUT.

modules.name: Attenuator
modules.description: Bipolar attenuator: centre off, clockwise up to unity, anticlockwise up to unity inverted. Input normalled to a positive voltage, so unpatched it is a ±8 V DC source.

modules.name: Attenuator reference
modules.description: Internal positive voltage normalled to the attenuator input.

modules.name: Mult
modules.description: Four unbuffered parallel jacks; any can be an input or output. Can merge two AC-coupled audio signals.

modules.name: Spring reverb
modules.description: 6-inch analogue spring reverb tank, with its own input and 100% wet rear output; sensitive to vibration and interference.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Reverb MIX blends dry VCA and wet reverb; VOLUME then sets the main/headphone level. The Eurorack out is taken after MIX, before VOLUME.

behaviours.name: Default signal path
behaviours.rule: Oscillators and noise (plus the instrument input) into the mixer, then the ladder filter, VCA, spring reverb and output. Keyboard CV to both oscillators and, by KBD TRACK, the filter; gate to the envelope. Patching OSC 1/2 IN, NOISE IN, FILTER INPUT, VCA IN, REVERB IN or TRIGGER IN breaks that normal. The high-pass filter, attenuator, mult and S/H are unpatched resources.

behaviours.name: Pitch inputs sum
behaviours.rule: OSC PITCH IN, LIN FM IN and the LFO add to the keyboard pitch; nothing breaks the keyboard normal except Local off.

behaviours.name: MOD wheel
behaviours.rule: PITCH AMT, CUTOFF AMT and PULSE WIDTH AMT set maximum depths; the MOD wheel sets how much is applied. At minimum MOD, no LFO modulation is heard. PWM needs a square or narrow pulse selected.

behaviours.name: VCA modes
behaviours.rule: ENV: envelope sets the level. KB RLS: full level on key down, then the envelope release on key up (a variant of the Moog KB GATE). DRONE: always on; a VCA AMT IN connection then sets the level alone.

behaviours.name: Mixer drive
behaviours.rule: The mixer is DC coupled, so it also sums CVs. Levels above 1 o'clock add gentle distortion, higher settings overdrive.

behaviours.name: Sample and hold
behaviours.rule: Noise is sampled at each zero crossing of the LFO. Patching GATE OUT to SYNC IN with RATE at minimum steps the S/H with each key.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator
behaviours.rule: Plays held notes in order, forward then backward, or randomly, over 1-3 octaves, at 20-280 BPM or synced divisions (MIDI, CLOCK IN, tap). HOLD latches; notes added while holding join the pattern.

behaviours.name: Sequencer
behaviours.rule: Three sequences of up to 256 steps, kept without power. REC then play notes; HOLD adds a rest, PLAY a tie, TAP an accent, overlapping keys give legato. SEQ ends recording; PLAY then a key starts it, and keys transpose. Edit only while playing (switch to REC during playback); a key in REC while stopped erases the sequence. Accents leave on KB VEL OUT as a fast envelope; patch it to CUTOFF IN to hear them.

behaviours.name: Velocity
behaviours.rule: The keyboard senses velocity but it is not wired internally; use KB VEL OUT or MIDI.

behaviours.name: Stuck notes
behaviours.rule: Holding all three left-hand buttons for about a second clears the note stack and sends All Notes Off.

midi.channel_note: Channel 1-16 in global settings; default 1. 14-bit pairs available for CC 1, 3, 5, 8 and 12.
midi.note: Only CC 1, 3, 5, 8 and 12 address analogue controls; switch-position CCs cover octaves, sync and the ARP/SEQ.

power.adaptor: 12 V DC, 2 A, positive tip; 100-240 V AC

omitted_from_source: the waveform and envelope primer text
the full clock division table values for CC 90
pitch bend and transpose CC value tables
not_in_source: LFO and oscillator pitch ranges in Hz beyond the panel footages
the attenuator reference voltage's exact value (output reaches ±8 V)
oscillator 2 FREQUENCY range options in global settings
source_inconsistencies: The overview page counts 41 patch points as 21 inputs and 20 outputs; the specifications give 21 inputs, 16 outputs and 4 mults.
The feature summary and CUTOFF text give a 10 Hz lower cutoff; the panel scale starts at 20 Hz.
Legato glide is toggled with HOLD + GLIDE in the left-hand controller section and with SHIFT + GLIDE in the sequencing tip.
MIDI CC 74 and 75 both list 32' as a value, but Oscillator 2's octave switch runs 16' to 2'.

modelling_gaps.detail: Four bidirectional parallel jacks are modelled as one input and three outputs on a shared bus.
A physical tank; its decay and colour are not documented.
